# raac-generated

Generated by `raac generate` from the raac.yaml next to this folder. Do not edit these files; change raac.yaml and run `raac generate` again. `raac generate --check` fails CI when they are out of date.

- `deploy/`: PodDisruptionBudget, HorizontalPodAutoscaler and Sloth PrometheusServiceLevel. Add this folder to your kustomization or Argo CD app. Render SLOs with your usual Sloth step.
- `chaos/`: Chaos Mesh experiments, labelled `raac.dev/apply: manual`. **Never add this folder to GitOps**: every sync would inject failures. Apply an experiment on purpose with `kubectl apply -f`, or let `raac test` run them.

If you delete the raac.yaml, delete this folder too.
